title: Jackson's cobblemon Pack
description: A Cobblemon Pack created for those who wish to play with the full features. Such as megas, Z-moves and many other features
body:
Jackson's Cobblemon Pack strives to enhance the default cobblemon experience with the inclusion of the many games gimmicks- such as megas, dynamax, z-moves and teras. With the inclusion of these gimmicks also includes a wider range of pokemon with functional models.

The intention of this modpack is for use on a server. For those wanting to run it on one, my advise is to double check to remove any clientside mods that may have snuck in. 

So go out there and get the proper pokemon experience, GO CATCH THEM ALL!!!
